# 🛠 Release v1.21.11-0.0.3-beta-WIP

This beta release introduces the **Keybox** mechanic, new decorative blocks, and critical fixes for item rendering.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This is a **Work In Progress (WIP)** build. Some features may be subject to change in the final release.

## 🗒 What's Changed

### 🔑 Key Mechanics & Crafting
* **Introduced the Keybox**: A new functional block. Key crafting has been moved from the vanilla Crafting Table to the Keybox for better gameplay progression.
* **Key Duplication**: Players can now use the Keybox to create copies of existing keys.

### 🏠 New Content
* **Cabinet Block**: Added a new decorative storage option (*Birch Box Cabinet* and variants).
* **Advancements**: Implemented new milestones for crafting the Keybox and duplicating keys.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes & Technical Improvements
* **Item Rendering Fix**: Corrected the `display` settings for custom models. Items like glass panes and cabinets now have the correct scale (`0.25`) when dropped on the ground.
* **Namespace Refactoring**: Cleaned up item IDs and translation keys to ensure consistency with the new 1.21.x resource system.
* **Resource Cleanup**: Added proper `items` definition files to ensure models are loaded correctly from `models/item/`.

## 📦 Installation
1. Ensure you are using **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft 1.21.11.
2. Download the `.jar` file from the assets below.
3. Drop the file into your `mods` folder.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Dima011099/UsefulDecor-Interactive-Craft/commits/v1.21.11-0.0.3
